name: Iconic Rides of Pop Culture
description: Questions covering: Bullitt, The Love Bug, The Green Hornet, Smokey and the Bandit, Jurassic Park...

questions.question: What model of vehicle did Steve McQueen drive during the famous chase scene in the film Bullitt?
questions.explanation_correct: The 1968 Ford Mustang GT Highland Green fastback is the iconic car used by Steve McQueen in the film.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Dodge Charger was the antagonist's vehicle, while the Camaro and Pontiac were not central to the film's chase.

questions.question: What is the name of the sentient Volkswagen Beetle featured in The Love Bug?
questions.explanation_correct: Herbie is the famous racing Volkswagen Beetle that displays human-like consciousness in the film series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other names are generic nicknames that do not refer to the titular vehicle from the movie.

questions.question: What is the name of the modified 1966 Chrysler Imperial in the 1960s television series The Green Hornet?
questions.explanation_correct: Black Beauty is the name of the customized crime-fighting car used by the Green Hornet and Kato in the 1960s series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are fictional names commonly associated with superhero vehicles but are not the correct title for this specific Chrysler.

questions.question: Which car did the lead character drive in Smokey and the Bandit to distract police officers?
questions.explanation_correct: The black and gold Pontiac Firebird Trans-Am is the central vehicle featured throughout the film.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While the other cars are classic muscle cars, they were not the signature vehicle used in this specific production.

questions.question: Which vehicle model served as the touring car during the events of the film Jurassic Park?
questions.explanation_correct: The Ford Explorer, identifiable by its park paint scheme, was the SUV used for the ill-fated tour.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Jeep Wrangler was also present on the island but was used by staff rather than for the primary guest tour.

questions.question: What is the name of the foot-powered stone vehicle used by the family in The Flintstones?
questions.explanation_correct: The Flintmobile is the cartoon car propelled by the occupants’ feet; it is not pedal-powered.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other names are invented terms that sound similar but are not the official name of the recurring vehicle.

questions.question: Which iconic mode of transportation is famously used by Diana Prince to travel undetected?
questions.explanation_correct: The Invisible Jet is a recurring transport vehicle used by Wonder Woman in various comic and film iterations.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are fictional concepts that are not the name of the character's signature aircraft.

questions.question: What is the name of Lady Penelope’s pink six-wheeled vehicle in the original Thunderbirds television series?
questions.explanation_correct: FAB 1 is the pink six-wheeled Rolls-Royce in the original television series; later adaptations use different designs.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are fabricated titles that do not match the specific vehicle designation from the series.

questions.question: Which massive, multi-part armored vehicle was driven by Furiosa in Mad Max: Fury Road?
questions.explanation_correct: The War Rig is the distinct, heavy-duty armored tanker that serves as the central vessel for the plot.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other names follow the naming convention of the movie but are not the specific title of the rig.

questions.question: Which car model became famous as Takumi Fujiwara's tofu delivery vehicle in Initial D?
questions.explanation_correct: The Toyota AE86, often called the Hachi-Roku, is the legendary car driven by the protagonist.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other cars appear in the series but are driven by different characters throughout the story.

questions.question: What is the nickname given to the 1976 AMC Pacer used by the characters in Wayne's World?
questions.explanation_correct: The Mirthmobile is the blue AMC Pacer with flame graphics featured in Wayne’s World.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are not the nickname of the Pacer in the film.

questions.question: What is the name given to the custom van styled like a shaggy dog in Dumb and Dumber?
questions.explanation_correct: The Mutt Cutts van is the vehicle designed to look exactly like a large dog, used by the protagonists.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are related to dogs but are not the specific title used for the van in the movie.

questions.question: What car form does Bumblebee take for much of the 2018 film Bumblebee?
questions.explanation_correct: In the 2018 film Bumblebee takes the form of a Volkswagen Beetle. In the 2007 Transformers film he is a Chevrolet Camaro.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other listed models are not Bumblebee’s Beetle form in the 2018 film.

questions.question: What was the nickname assigned to the gadget-laden Lotus Esprit seen in The Spy Who Loved Me?
questions.explanation_correct: Wet Nellie is the tongue-in-cheek nickname given to the submersible Lotus by the production team.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other names are thematic guesses related to the submarine capability but lack the specific historical reference.

questions.question: Which white supercar is best remembered as Sonny Crockett's primary ride in Miami Vice?
questions.explanation_correct: The white Ferrari Testarossa became a quintessential visual element of the 1980s television show.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other cars represents the luxury sport segment of the era, though they were not the specific model used by the lead actor.

questions.question: Which of these is the name of a G.I. Joe tank in the toy and animated franchise?
questions.explanation_correct: The Mauler is a tank associated with G.I. Joe. The franchise features other vehicles and tanks as well.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options do not name the Mauler.

questions.question: Which vehicle was driven by the villain Dick Dastardly in the Wacky Races cartoon?
questions.explanation_correct: The Mean Machine is the long, purple, rocket-powered car piloted by Dick Dastardly and his dog Mutley.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other titles are similar in tone but do not refer to the actual vehicle name from the series.

questions.question: What is the official model name of the wood-paneled station wagon from National Lampoon's Vacation?
questions.explanation_correct: The Wagon Queen Family Truckster is the parody name for the heavily modified station wagon driven by the Griswolds.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are plausible sounding names but are not the specific fictional title used in the film.

questions.question: What is the nickname for the union jack-painted Jaguar used as a spy car in Austin Powers?
questions.explanation_correct: The Shaguar is the pun-filled name given to the E-Type Jaguar featured in the Austin Powers series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are themes relating to the film's character but are not recognized vehicle names.

questions.question: What are the flying police vehicles in Blade Runner called?
questions.explanation_correct: Spinners are the iconic vertical-takeoff-and-landing automobiles seen navigating the future city of Los Angeles in Blade Runner.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other choices are descriptive but do not correspond to the specific set terminology used in the motion picture.

questions.question: What is the specific model year of the prized Ford Gran Torino featured in the 2008 film of the same name?
questions.explanation_correct: The film centers on a 1972 Ford Gran Torino Sport, which the protagonist Walt Kowalski helped assemble.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While Ford produced Gran Torinos throughout the early 70s, the 1972 model is the specific one featured in the movie.

questions.question: Which make of customized 1950 coupe does Marion Cobretti drive in the 1986 film Cobra?
questions.explanation_correct: Cobretti drives a customized 1950 Mercury coupe.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The car in Cobra is a Mercury; the other options are different makes.

questions.question: Which painter’s geometric style inspired the multicolored bus in The Partridge Family?
questions.explanation_correct: The Partridge Family bus features a colorful geometric paint scheme associated with Piet Mondrian’s style.

questions.question: In the film RoboCop, which fictional, poorly marketed vehicle is the subject of high-end television commercials?
questions.explanation_correct: The 6000 SUX is depicted as a luxury vehicle that famously gets terrible gas mileage.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These are variations on the fictional name created for the film to sound pseudo-futuristic.

questions.question: What is the affectionate nickname Dean Winchester gives his car in Supernatural?
questions.explanation_correct: Dean Winchester affectionately refers to his car as Baby throughout the series.

questions.question: Which car does Joel drive into a lake in the film Risky Business?

questions.question: Which British sports car is driven by Number Six in the opening of The Prisoner?

questions.question: What type of car does the Driver utilize as his stock, non-descript vehicle during the opening heist of Drive?

questions.question: What is the specific model of the police truck driven by Jim Hopper in Stranger Things?
questions.explanation_correct: Sheriff Hopper's law enforcement vehicle is historically depicted as a Chevrolet K5 Blazer.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These are all iconic SUVs from the period, which causes common confusion regarding the Sheriff's exact vehicle.

questions.question: What is the racing vehicle driven by Steve McQueen in the film Le Mans?
questions.explanation_correct: Steve McQueen's character Michael Delaney drives the legendary Porsche 917 during the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other vehicles were famous competitors in real world endurance racing during that time period, leading to frequent misidentification.

questions.question: Which Ford racing car won the 1966 24 Hours of Le Mans, with Carroll Shelby’s team involved in the program?
questions.explanation_correct: The Ford GT40 Mk II won Le Mans in 1966. Its development involved Ford, Ford Advanced Vehicles, Shelby American and other contributors.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other Ford and Shelby models were not the GT40 Mk II that won the race in 1966.

questions.question: Which mid-sized sedan is regularly used by Fox Mulder in his X-Files field investigations?
questions.explanation_correct: Fox Mulder is most famously associated with driving various models of the Ford Taurus during his work for the FBI.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These were common fleet vehicles for federal agencies in the 90s, often confused with the Taurus due to similar styling.

questions.question: Which off-road vehicle is used by park staff in the 1993 film Jurassic Park?
questions.explanation_correct: Park staff use Jeep Wranglers; the visitor tour vehicles are Ford Explorers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Ford Explorer is the tour vehicle; the staff vehicle described here is a Jeep Wrangler.
